what: Crossref check of the dataset paper cited for UJI_LIB_DB_Floor_3 in the multi-dataset report and deck (src/make_multi_dataset_report_docx.py, src/make_multi_dataset_deck.py). The DOI was resolved at api.crossref.org; title, authors and year match the work intended. DLULIB, HCXY and HUS ship without documentation in the dataset folder, so no source is cited for them.
